self_update_gaps.title: TKP produces new tribal knowledge, but machine roadmaps don't subscribe to promotions
self_update_gaps.description: TKP Wave TK-0..TK-7 builds canonical knowledge (tribal tips, playbook rules, formulas), but LATHE/MILL/MT/GRIND/LASER/WATERJET/WIRE roadmaps have NO HOOK to detect and consume promoted knowledge
self_update_gaps.impact: Downstream machine roadmaps inherit stale knowledge sources; new tribal knowledge propagates to engines but not roadmaps
self_update_gaps.example: TKP Wave TK-1 promotes 'Haas lathe M100 spindle dwell = 2.5s (not 1s)' → live in TurningPrintToProgramEngine, but LATHE-MS5 session still lists generic MASTER KNOWLEDGE SOURCES
self_update_gaps.required_solution: KnowledgeSourceUpdateHook (MCP action + protective hook) subscribes to TKP promotion queue

self_update_gaps.title: Per-session knowledge sources declared but not validated for completeness
self_update_gaps.description: Sessions inherit global MASTER SOURCES + add local sources, but no validation that all required categories are covered (ENGINES, TRIBAL_TIPS, PLAYBOOK, CONSTANTS, FORMULAS, REFERENCE)
self_update_gaps.impact: Sessions might be missing critical sources without author realizing
self_update_gaps.example: LATHE-MS0 declares 5 engines but never cites FormulaRegistry → next editor might not realize formulas are needed for this session

self_update_gaps.title: No explicit EXCLUDED SOURCES marking on sessions
self_update_gaps.description: Sessions inherit global sources but don't declare which ones DON'T apply. Readers assume all inherited sources are active.
self_update_gaps.impact: Sessions carry implicit bloat; risk of wrong anti-patterns applied
self_update_gaps.example: LATHE session reads all 296 MachiningPlaybookEngine rules, includes milling-specific rules by default
self_update_gaps.required_solution: Add 'EXCLUDED SOURCES' section to per-session knowledge blocks with rationales

scoring.duplication_risk_interpretation: Moderate — 7 repetitions of same sources; high risk if any source updates require multi-roadmap sync
scoring.source_hierarchy_interpretation: High — All 7 roadmaps list formulas before constants, systematically violating hierarchy
scoring.self_update_gap_interpretation: CRITICAL — 0/8 roadmaps subscribe to TKP feedback; new tribal knowledge doesn't auto-reach roadmaps
scoring.per_session_knowledge_interpretation: Minor — Sessions do declare per-milestone sources, just lack exclusions + completeness validation
scoring.overall_interpretation: Knowledge source documentation is well-structured but fragmented and static. Self-update mechanism missing. Risk: SVI stalls because tribal knowledge propagates to engines but not roadmaps; sessions inherit frozen knowledge snapshots.
